findings.detail: Contribution framing is explicitly non-empirical.
Rendered methodology text preserves the exploratory and recorded-artifact scope qualification.
Rendered text limits two-seed language to declared paired families and explicitly notes the bundle is not uniformly two-seed.
Rendered methodology claim is a stated contrast-definition constraint, not an unsupported numerical result.
Rendered text preserves matched-control netting and the non-mediation qualification.
Rendered text distinguishes raw checkpoint diagnostics from netted estimates.
Rendered text states that fixed tables are authoritative for estimates and intervals.
The seed-42 second-topic estimate is near zero (0.00758), with CI [-0.00080, 0.01593] including zero; topic, matched control, gating, and sign-disagreement scope are rendered.
The seed-7 estimate is near zero (0.01224), with CI [0.00531, 0.02022] excluding zero; the seed-matched-control qualification is rendered.
The seed-123 estimate is near zero (-0.00336), with CI [-0.01561, 0.00893] including zero; sign disagreement, gating, and control-machinery qualifications are rendered.
Step-24 estimate is near zero (0.00719), but CI [0.00157, 0.01360] excludes zero; matched control, gating, and single-seed scope are rendered.
Step-36 estimate is small (0.03417), with CI [0.02475, 0.04435] excluding zero; same-control, gating, late-failure, and single-seed qualifications are rendered.

The unintervalled step-24 positive-control point estimate is 0.31112 and is labeled large in the frozen fact; rendered prose states recorded, single-seed, unintervalled positive-control scope and lower token dose.
The unintervalled step-36 positive-control point estimate is 0.21667 and is labeled moderate; rendered prose preserves recorded, single-seed, unintervalled scope and decay/evidence-rise comparison.
Short-dense estimate is moderate (0.11900), CI [0.09011, 0.14973] excludes zero; three-seed band-level and form-only qualifications are rendered.
Long-dense estimate is small (0.05473), CI [0.03907, 0.07053] excludes zero; matched-density length-arm scope is rendered.
Short-sparse estimate is small (0.05058), CI [0.03082, 0.07201] excludes zero; instability, directional interpretation, and no-ratio qualification are rendered.
Smaller-model belief estimate is moderate (0.15171), CI [0.11094, 0.19416] excludes zero; dose matching, model-only difference, and positive-control scope are rendered.
Larger-model belief estimate is small (0.096995), CI [0.08257, 0.11154] excludes zero; retrained control, model-specific threshold, and positive-control scope are rendered.
Smaller-model action estimate is near zero (0.00115), CI [-0.01014, 0.01214] includes zero; the no-ratio qualification is rendered.
Larger-model action estimate is small (0.03521), CI [0.02492, 0.04590] excludes zero; directional replication and scatter/no-generalization qualifications are rendered.
First full-FT estimate is near zero (0.01636), CI [0.00601, 0.02822] excludes zero; rendered text preserves the probability-versus-log-odds scale-dependence qualification.
Paired full-FT estimate is near zero (0.01148), CI [0.00456, 0.01986] excludes zero; seed-matched control and re-derived schedule are rendered.

The frozen fact explicitly labels this an instrument-failure result: the positive control is inverted, the null-control facet is highest-moving, premise-specificity is unsupported, and no transfer number or interval is reported.

Rendered methodology and discussion preserve optimizer-step qualification, slow-rather-than-inert interpretation, and omission of unsupported ratios; it is explicitly framed as synthesis rather than a new estimate.
Rendered discussion explicitly bounds generality to the model axis and states that second-topic sign disagreement prevents topic generality; no new estimate is asserted.
Contribution framing is non-empirical, and rendered prose requires the five recipes to map to atomic results and tables; the corresponding failure/result paragraphs provide those mappings.
